articles.summary: Juniper Ridge Landfill plays a critical role in helping Maine communities safely and responsibly manage waste every day. Through facility tours and educational outreach, the team opens its doors to students and community members, providing a firsthand look at the people, processes, and infrastructure behind modern landfill operations.
articles.title: A New View: Building Understanding Through Community Tours at Juniper Ridge Landfill

articles.summary: At just 18 years old, Mason Harrongton is already building the foundation for a long-term career. After first learning about Casella through visits from company recruiters at his high school, Mason joined the Burlington, VT team as a helper, where he gained firsthand experience alongside seasoned drivers and developed a deeper understanding of the industry's strong safety culture.
articles.title: Driven to Grow: Mason Harrington

articles.summary: Casella's Operations team drives safe, reliable service and operational excellence across the company. Since joining as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer in July 2026, Damian Ribar has brought more than 30 years of industry experience and a strong focus on safety, people, and performance. He is helping position Casella for continued growth through operational excellence, innovation, and employee development.
articles.title: Leading Through Growth: Meet Damian Ribar

articles.summary: Sometimes the best opportunities are the ones you never expected. For Josanuel "Joe" Torres Alomar, it started with a conversation, a willingness to try something new, and the opportunity to earn a CDL through Casella. What began as a first job after high school has grown into a rewarding career built on training, mentorship, meaningful customer relationships, and opportunities for advancement.
articles.title: Steering Toward New Opportunities: CDL Driver Joe Torres Alomar
